notes: Group 1: معبد is the transmitter; the visit to Anas (with ثابت) is the scene; Anas speaks «حدثنا محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم», so he is the last link.

Group 2: the second isnad for the same saying, from the Basran Hasan who says «لقد حدثني» about Anas. Its head (the companions who went to Hasan) is not named in the text, so only الحسن and أنس are written.
